Message: Chandan ji, aapke 7th lord Mars ki sthiti bata rahi hai ki aage chal kar arranged marriage ke yog zyada ban rahe hain, jismein parivar ka bada haath hoga.
Nehi meri relief mein क्या-क्या ghatega uska pata mujhe lagana hai
Bataiye, kya aajkal aapke mann mein marriage ko lekar koi khaas sawaal chal raha hai?
Iska matlab hai ki aapke vyaktitva mein ek natural charm aur aakarshan hai jo dusron ko bahut jaldi pasand aata hai.
Libra lagna hai aapka, aur Venus lagna mein baitha hai.
Chandan ji, aapki kundli dekh rahi hoon.
Namaste Chandan ji, welcome. Aapka swagat hai.
